appearance.subtle: Their teeth look heavier than they should.
appearance.obvious: Their teeth are thick and pointed, crowding the front of their mouth.
appearance.extreme: Their mouth is full of dense conical teeth, too many and too large, and their lips do not entirely close over them.

description: Your teeth have thickened and come to points. A bite means something now, and so does a smile.
drawbacks: You cannot talk without showing them
name: Calcified Teeth
